claim_scores.rationale: Uses `BootstrapFewShotWithRandomSearch(..., num_candidate_programs=1)`, matching the parameter that becomes `self.num_candidate_sets`.
Asserts `len(seeds) == 4`, which matches the four evaluated candidates from seeds `-3, -2, -1, 0` when one candidate set is requested.
Extracts and asserts the exact stored seeds `{-3, -2, -1, 0}`, the expected identifiers for the three baselines plus the single random candidate.
Inspects `best.candidate_programs` directly via `[candidate["seed"] for candidate in best.candidate_programs]` and asserts both stored count and seeds.
